Citymaker.Recipe.MemorialPark.Descriptio: An axial procession to a focal monument, a reflecting pool, hedged garden rooms and quiet lighting.
Citymaker.Memorial.Name: Memorial park
Citymaker.Memorial.style.Tooltip: Sets the character: garden, paved square, war memorial, reflection garden or a sculpture park with a trail instead of an axis.
Citymaker.Memorial.focal.Tooltip: The monument closes the axis at the far end, or stands in the centre with the axis running on.
Citymaker.Memorial.processionWidth.Toolt: Width of the processional way (8 m and more uses a wide path; the paved strip follows it when Paved procession is on).
Citymaker.Memorial.crossAxis.Tooltip: A second path crossing the main axis at the monument.
Citymaker.Memorial.paving.Tooltip: Lays a paved strip under the procession path and small pads under the trail sculptures. The walks themselves are always paths.
Citymaker.Memorial.forecourt.Tooltip: Radius (half-width for square courts) of the paved forecourt round the monument.
Citymaker.Memorial.raised.Tooltip: Raises the forecourt on a mound blended back to the ground (permanent terrain change).
Citymaker.Memorial.plaques.Tooltip: Plaques or wreaths in an arc before the monument (memorial stones when none are installed).
Citymaker.Memorial.sculptures.Tooltip: Sculptures on pads beside the trail (sculpture park).
Citymaker.Memorial.pool.Tooltip: A long pool on the axis; the walk splits round it.
Citymaker.Memorial.poolLength.Tooltip: Share of the procession the pool takes.
Citymaker.Memorial.realWater.Tooltip: Digs a shallow basin with real water (flat ground only, permanent). Otherwise a water-look surface.
Citymaker.Memorial.rooms.Tooltip: Quiet garden rooms enclosed by hedges, opening towards the axis.
Citymaker.Memorial.roomContent.Tooltip: What each room holds; Mixed alternates by memorial type.
Citymaker.Memorial.allees.Tooltip: Rows of trees either side of the procession, always in pairs.
Citymaker.Memorial.lawnTrees.Tooltip: Trees on the lawns, never in the view along the axis.
Citymaker.Memorial.bosque.Tooltip: The lawns either side of the axis planted as regular groves of trees, mirrored across the axis.
Citymaker.Memorial.borders.Tooltip: A ribbon of flowerbeds (poppies for a war memorial) either side of the procession.
Citymaker.Memorial.monumentScale.Tooltip: How large the focal monument (or the trail's sculptures) stands, relative to the piece's own size.
Citymaker.Memorial.flowerRing.Tooltip: Flowerbeds round the forecourt (poppies for a war memorial).
Citymaker.Memorial.lighting.Tooltip: Solemn lighting: low bollard lights, lantern pairs, uplights on the monument and rooms only, or none.
Citymaker.Memorial.enclosure.Tooltip: A hedge or a fence round the park, with gaps at the entrances.
Citymaker.Memorial.Feature.flagCircle.To: A small round court with flagpoles on its rim and a plaque in the middle.
Citymaker.Memorial.Issue.NoAxis: The outline leaves no room for an axis; the memorial follows a trail instead.
Citymaker.Memorial.Issue.AxisBroken: Part of the procession would leave the area and was left out.
Citymaker.Memorial.Issue.NoPool: No room for the reflecting pool.
Citymaker.Memorial.Issue.PoolNotFlat: The ground under the pool is not flat (or raised); a water-look surface is used instead of real water.
Citymaker.Memorial.Issue.PoolPermanent: The pool basin is dug into the terrain permanently.
Citymaker.Memorial.Issue.FewerSculptures: Only {0} of {1} sculptures fit beside the trail.
Citymaker.AddOn.FlagCircle.Name: Flag circle
